payload.name: slice
payload.description: Load a space for this turn as a slice: nodes, edges, axes, and the proposals still waiting as ghosts. Your own space whole; the operator’s through its blessed sources and what he has blessed across.

query.description: Keep only nodes whose text mentions this.

space.description: The space to read: your own, or the operator’s through what he has blessed.

topK.description: Keep at most this many, newest first.

payload.name: reflect
payload.description: Record what this session noticed, in the shape the next session can retrieve. Lands in your own space at once; a proposal to carry it into the operator’s memory waits for blessing. Outcomes you report on applied patches are the loop’s own measure.

attempted.description: What this session set out to do, in one sentence.

cites.description: The nodes you read, by space and id, with the span if it matters.

inferred.description: What you concluded from the observations. Kept apart from them.

observed.description: What actually happened. Facts a later session can rely on, one per entry.

outcomes.description: For each applied patch `orient` showed you: was its hypothesis confirmed or contradicted by this session, and why.

shouldChange.description: What a prompt, skill, verb, or policy should do differently, and why. A wish; `propose` is the patch.

payload.name: propose
payload.description: Propose a change to one of the operator’s nodes: its whole new text, against the base you read, with why and what should be observable if it worked. The fabric evaluates what it can and the patch waits in his space; only his terminal applies it, and only to the base you named.

because.description: What you observed that this change answers.

body.description: The node’s whole new text. A patch is the text, not a diff.

hypothesis.description: What the next session should observe if the change worked, stated so it can fail. It is what that session reports on.

node.description: The node to change, by id, as the operator’s slice names it: today `skill/<name>`.

payload.name: recall
payload.description: Ask your memory a question. Resonance ranks the reflections nearest it; those are compiled into claims and events with their times and quantities, conflicts between them are named, and the compile answers as far as it can. Without a compiler wired, it says so.

payload.name: pending
payload.description: What is still waiting in a space: the proposals to carry a node across, and the patches to change one, each with what the fabric could check. Offered and not yet answered.

space.description: The space whose gap to count.

payload.name: sync
payload.description: Report the drift between each sibling repository’s pinned commit and its remote. No pin moves; advancing one is a pull request.
